title: Contents Packout & Storage Pack-Back Box Line of a Return
content:
**Scope.** This Contents Packout & Storage policy prices the pack-back box line of a return on a Partial Contents Packout, Full Contents Packout, High-Value Contents Packout or Commercial Contents and Records Recovery job, and only that line: it is charged once the job is in returned status, dated the job's returned date, at most once per return.

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Tiers | Partial, Full and High-Value Contents Packout; Commercial Contents and Records Recovery |
| When it is charged | once the job is in returned status |
| Date of the line | the job's returned date |
| How often | at most once per return |

## Booking the line: `charge_pack_back_boxes_26b5c86b`

**Capability.** The tool books the pack-back box line of a return on a contents job: it adds one move-back charge with charge code pack-back box, dated the day the boxes were brought back and unpacked, to the named contents job, and raises the job's balance due by the same amount. The customer can see the new move-back line and the higher balance on the job straight away. A second call for the same job, date and amount books nothing new: it returns status `already_booked` with that line's id and leaves the balance due unchanged.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `charge_pack_back_boxes_26b5c86b` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `contents_job_id` | the reference number of the contents job the move-back line belongs to, as returned by the contents job lookup | identifier |
| `service_date` | the date the move-back work was performed | calendar date written YYYY-MM-DD, no time part |
| `amount` | the line amount in USD | a positive figure rounded to 2 decimal places, half up |

**Return.** A receipt with `status` (booked when the line was added), `contents_charge_id` (reference number of the new move-back line), `contents_job_id`, `charge_code` (always `pack_back_box`), `service_date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `amount` (USD, 2 decimal places) and `balance_due` (after the line, USD, 2 decimal places). A repeated call with the same job, date and amount returns status `already_booked` with the existing line's `contents_charge_id`, `contents_job_id`, `amount` and the unchanged `balance_due`.

**Errors.** "service_date must be a calendar date written YYYY-MM-DD."; "amount must be a positive USD figure."
